note: Stable rule codes for checking and delivering a .sov. A code is never reused or renumbered; a retired code stays listed with retired true. scripts/validate_sov.mjs matches validator messages against `match` in the order listed (first match wins); scripts/deliver_sov.py emits the render codes itself. docs/RULE-CODES.md lists every code (tests/deliver_qa.py checks both ways). In `repair`, {id} is the element the finding names and {detail} the validator's own upper-case code.

rules.title: file cannot be read
rules.repair: Check the path; the file must exist and be readable.

rules.title: file is not JSON
rules.repair: Fix the JSON syntax at the position the message names; a .sov is one JSON object.

rules.title: payload is not an object
rules.repair: Wrap the document in one JSON object with "schema", "components", "wires" and "references".

rules.title: file schema unsupported
rules.repair: Set "schema" to the document schema (see GET /api/v1/formats, field document).

rules.title: package refused
rules.repair: The package's inner document failed; fix the errors listed in the message, which are the document's own.

rules.title: document schema mismatch
rules.repair: Set "schema" to the value the message names.

rules.title: document shape
rules.repair: Give the document "components", "wires" and "references" as arrays (empty is allowed).

rules.title: record has no id
rules.repair: Give every component, wire and reference a non-empty "id".

rules.title: duplicate id
rules.repair: Rename one of the records called {id}; ids are unique per kind.

rules.title: narration malformed
rules.repair: Write narration as an array of {"at": <tick>, "say": "..."}; every line needs a say string.

rules.title: time scale invalid
rules.repair: Set meta.timeScale to a finite number >= 0, or remove it.

rules.title: palette invalid
rules.repair: Set meta.palette to a known palette name (the message lists them) or {"custom": [six "#RRGGBB" hexes]}, or remove it.

rules.title: section bands do not fit lines
rules.match: section: bands must be one fewer than lines
rules.repair: On {id}, give form.section exactly one band fewer than it has lines.

rules.title: card shape invalid
rules.repair: On {id}, use a card shape the message lists, or remove the shape.

rules.title: badge invalid
rules.repair: On {id}, correct config.badge as the message says, or remove it.

rules.title: intake invalid
rules.repair: On {id}, correct the intake field the message names, or remove it.

rules.title: declared ports invalid
rules.repair: On {id}, correct the declared ports the message names; a port still carrying a wire cannot be removed.

rules.title: virtual definition invalid
rules.repair: Correct the virtual definition or instance on {id} ({detail}) as the message says.

rules.title: wire end names no component
rules.repair: On wire {id}, point the end at an existing component id, or create that component.

rules.title: wire ports share no channel
rules.repair: On wire {id}, attach the ends to ports that share a channel, or give one port the other's channel.

rules.title: wire crosses a boundary
rules.repair: On wire {id}, route through a port the boundary exposes, or move both ends onto one surface.

rules.title: wire canvasId disagrees with its ends
rules.repair: On wire {id}, set "canvasId" to the surface the message names, or remove canvasId so the loader derives it.

rules.title: wire end has no surface
rules.match: wire endpoint exposes no surface|wire endpoint component not found|invalid attachment
rules.repair: On wire {id}, attach the end to a component port or attachment point that exists on a reachable surface.

rules.title: wire operation invalid
rules.repair: On wire {id}, set forwardOperation and reverseOperation to none, read or write.

rules.title: wire kind not declared
rules.repair: On wire {id}, use a wire kind the notation declares, or declare it in the notation.

rules.title: path delay invalid
rules.repair: On {id}, set the delay to a finite number >= 0, or remove it.

rules.title: notation does not resolve
rules.repair: Name a notation that exists, or correct the scale or glyph size the message names.

rules.title: notation kind rule broken
rules.repair: In the notation, correct the kind entry the message names.

rules.title: notation concern rule broken
rules.repair: In the notation, correct the concern entry the message names.

rules.title: status not declared
rules.repair: On {id}, use a status the notation declares, declare it in the notation, or remove config.status.

rules.title: waits-on invalid
rules.repair: On {id}, write config.waitsOn as a list of {"kind": person|rule|decision, "id": "..."}.

rules.title: concern answer invalid
rules.repair: Answer only concerns the notation declares for {id}, each with a non-empty string ({detail}).

rules.title: group membership invalid
rules.repair: Fix group {id} ({detail}): every member exists once, sits on the group's canvas, and is not itself a group or hosted.

rules.title: editor failed while drawing
rules.repair: The editor raised an error opening or drawing the document; the message holds it. Open the file in the editor to see the same error.

rules.title: picture is empty
rules.repair: The light or dark picture came out empty; check that the document has placed components on its default layout.

rules.title: viewer shows another document
rules.repair: The viewer's id or card count differs from the checked file; the editor refused the file and kept another. Open it in the editor to see why.

rules.title: renderer unavailable
rules.repair: Install Playwright Chromium (python -m playwright install chromium) and build index.html (python build.py).

rules.title: wire blocked for tracing
rules.repair: Wire {id} is drawn but tracing does not follow it ({detail}); expected for an access-blocked wire, otherwise open its direction or access.

rules.title: unclassified finding
rules.repair: The validator reported a message no rule code covers yet; fix what it says and file the message so a code can be added.
